scope_definition: Stage2-C Structural Timber Scope includes physical timber components, indispensable timber connector roles, and timber-system handoffs required to form a continuous deterministic structural-timber assembly network. It excludes enclosure, masonry/foundation, roof covering/ornament, interior furnishing, and organizational containers. The scope stops at explicit lower/upper structural handoff boundaries rather than expanding into the whole building.
inclusion_tests: IN if the object is an approved structural-timber Master-bound production object.
IN if it is a real timber connector/member/system whose omission would leave an unexplained break in the structural timber assembly chain.
IN as boundary handoff if Stage2-C must connect to it to terminate the timber chain deterministically.
CONTAINER if it organizes components but is not a physical object.
OUT if it belongs to enclosure, foundation/masonry, roof covering/ornament, interior furnishing, or is a non-physical reference boundary.
CONDITIONAL only when physical timber existence is known but its independent Stage2-C connection role is not yet established.

lower.effect: 台基整体、角石 and below-foundation systems remain OUT; Stage2-C does not propagate into masonry/foundation.

upper.effect: 瓦、正脊/垂脊/戗脊、吻兽/仙人 remain OUT.

enclosure.effect: 门木作、窗木作、墙体/墙砖 and openings remain OUT.

corner_ornament.effect: ornaments remain OUT even if a terminal attachment exists.

summary.lock_gate: CONDITIONAL item must receive final IN/OUT disposition before register lock.
